projects.projectName: Red Hat - North America Salesforce POD / Red Hat, Inc. - IGA/IAM Implementation

riskDescription.context: Following the Red Hat–IBM organizational transition, key stakeholder Ryan (Product Owner, Architect, Platform Lead, primary decision-maker) is transitioning out, creating concentration risk across multiple critical roles. Limited stakeholder availability for key decisions and reliance on IBM for product fixes are creating uncertainty.
riskDescription.consequence: Project continuity uncertainty, resource utilization gaps, delivery timeline delays, funding uncertainty, and potential loss of critical institutional knowledge affecting business benefits realization.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish formal transition plan with defined roles, RACI matrix, and knowledge transfer sessions by December 15, 2026 to prevent leadership vacuum.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon Ryan's departure, immediately activate backup decision authority through escalation to IBM portfolio leadership and engage alternate architect within 48 hours to limit delivery disruption.

riskDescription.context: Scope and delivery expectations are evolving without a formally approved SOW/CR, while support has been extended at no additional cost until September 2026 without formal contractual clarity.
riskDescription.consequence: Revenue leakage, continued effort without clear commercial coverage, ambiguities regarding deliverables, roles/responsibilities, payment terms, and potential contractual disputes.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Submit formal Change Request with client Job Description gap analysis and secure SOW sign-off by January 31, 2027 to prevent revenue leakage.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If SOW approval is not obtained by March 2027, escalate to client executive sponsor and suspend non-contracted scope expansion to protect margin.

riskDescription.context: Challenges in the clarity of the scope/feature to be implemented in Verify application. Original SOW and requirements need clarification. Design or integration contracts may materially change.
riskDescription.consequence: Scope changes, rework, additional development/testing effort, destabilized sprint commitments, and potential impact to the planned end-of-November Production timeline.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct requirements clarification workshop with stakeholders by December 10, 2026 and establish formal scope change approval procedure to prevent scope creep.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Once scope changes exceed 15% of baseline, rebaseline delivery plan with client, prioritize critical-path functionality, and agree on phased delivery to limit timeline impact.

riskDescription.context: Multiple vendors operating across different departments with EDW source systems outside project scope. No clear EDW ownership and no detailed architecture for this complex project. Data anomalies from previous migrations (DaaS 1.0 to DaaS 2.0) attributed to EDW layer changes.
riskDescription.consequence: Upstream changes from other vendors may cause data anomalies, integration failures, and impact to downstream layers (EDW, Stage, ADM), leading to quality issues and delivery delays.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Define EDW ownership, RACI matrix, and detailed architecture covering all layers (EDW-ADM-Reporting) by December 20, 2026 with weekly upstream change reviews to prevent integration failures.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When upstream changes cause anomalies, activate issue tracking governance (DSR/WSR/MBR), engage backup vendor immediately, and implement data validation checkpoints to limit downstream impact.

riskDescription.context: Formal bi-weekly status reports, SLA reporting, and delivery metrics defined in the SOW are not consistently produced or shared with the client. Limited EM access to SOW details creates uncertainty around scope and SLAs.
riskDescription.consequence: Governance gaps, reduced delivery predictability, stakeholder misalignment, potential SLA violations, and weakened client confidence in project management.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement automated bi-weekly status reporting with SLA metrics dashboard and grant EM full SOW access by December 5, 2026 to prevent governance gaps.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should SLA violations occur, escalate to client within 24 hours, provide root cause analysis, and implement corrective action plan with weekly monitoring to limit reputational impact.
